# help flags
exhaustive -h
stdout -count=1 '^usage: exhaustive \[-B\] \[-casenil\] \[-d\] .+'
stdout -count=1 '^                  \[-check string\] .+'
stdout -count=1 '^[[:space:]]+ .+ \[-typeonly regexp\] \[packages\]$'
stdout -count=1 '^       exhaustive -h \| -help$'
stdout -count=1 '^The exhaustive command .+'
stdout -count=1 '^[[:space:]]+-B[[:space:]]+Disregard enumerated constants that are .+'
stderr ^$

exhaustive -help # same as -h above
stdout -count=1 '^usage: exhaustive \[-B\] \[-casenil\] \[-d\] .+'
stdout -count=1 '^                  \[-check string\] .+'
stdout -count=1 '^[[:space:]]+ .+ \[-typeonly regexp\] \[packages\]$'
stdout -count=1 '^       exhaustive -h \| -help$'
stdout -count=1 '^The exhaustive command .+'
stdout -count=1 '^[[:space:]]+-B[[:space:]]+Disregard enumerated constants that are .+'
stderr ^$

# undefined flag
! exhaustive -xx
stdout ^$
stderr -count=5 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^flag provided but not defined: -xx$'
stderr -count=1 '^usage: exhaustive \[-B\] \[-casenil\] \[-d\] .+'
stderr -count=1 '^                  \[-check string\] .+'
stderr -count=1 '^[[:space:]]+ .+ \[-typeonly regexp\] \[packages\]$'
stderr -count=1 '^       exhaustive -h \| -help$'

# -check flag
cd $WORK/example.com
! exhaustive -check='' example.com/foo
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^exhaustive: invalid value for -check: empty string$'

! exhaustive -check='switch,xyz' example.com/foo
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^exhaustive: invalid value for -check: unknown element "xyz"$'

! exhaustive -check='switch, typeswitch' example.com/foo
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^exhaustive: invalid value for -check: unknown element " typeswitch"$'

-- example.com/go.mod --
module example.com
go 1.26.0

-- example.com/foo/foo.go --
package foo
